letheiafacility01.text: The entire facility appears to be surrounded by a jamming signal. I won't be able to get to you once you get any closer, so you'll be on your own.

letheiafacility01a.text: Good luck, soldier. I get the feeling you'll need it. Letheia doesn't mess around when it comes to its security.

letheiafleet01.text: Scans indicate the corporate fleet consists of a battleship, a carrier, a tanker, and numerous other small vessels.

letheiafleet01a.text: In order to board the battleship's main segment, you will need to activate IFF signals on the bridges of the carrier and tanker.

letheiafleet01b.text: Due to the size of the fleet, your mech's initial energy reserves may be insufficient, especially if you sustain damage from their defenses.

letheiafleet01c.text: Boarding ships and raiding their energy stores may very well be crucial to your success. Good luck.
